title: The Molding of Adam by Saklas
description: The Lord is intent in his heart upon humanity. This is the secret behind the molding of Adam and Eve. The Lord manifests his image; the proprium, struck by it but having no answering form of its own, presses the image inward and from that inward press shapes a likeness — a humanity built by self-love after a pattern it could not invent. The man and woman the proprium molds are made according to the image of the Most High but only as likeness, not in truth. The Lord's call into the rational does not come for the sake of the proprium that did this molding; it comes for the sake of the soul suffering inside the molded form — to raise that soul, to loosen what holds it, to redeem it out of its affliction. The proprium imitates again at this coming, but a true seal pressed into corrupt substance still bears the impress of the Most High.
